title: Function signature mismatch: tx_queue_count const vs non-const
description: Implementation at line 387 declares 'int tx_queue_count(const struct tx_queue *queue)' but header tx_queue.h:192 declares 'int tx_queue_count(struct tx_queue *_Nonnull queue)' without const. Compiler error: 'conflicting types for tx_queue_count'.
close_reason: Fixed: added const to header declaration (line 192) to match implementation. Updated doc comment from 'non-const due to internal locking' to 'logically const; locking cast internal'.
